title: Pay every step of the one-species positive-certificate constructor
statement: The symmetrization, gcd/extended-Euclid word, exact prefix/tail component and finite lifted prefix resistances form one terminating algorithm for all supplied one-species rational complex-balanced instances. With complete binary length B and explicitly computed a,L,s_j, set H=10+2^B+a+L+max|s_j|. The source bounds collapsed states by a+1, examined edges by O(a*reactioncount), lifted paths by O(H^2) edges at populations<=4H, individual factorial/power/rate heights by O(H^2), resistance terms by O(H^3), accumulated rational height by(10+H)^8 and total schoolbook BIT work by(10+H)^40. These are finite computable bounds, not polynomial in B or practical bounds. The recorded0<->2A,0<->3A,c=1 fixture gives word(-2,+3),a=2,C_tail=48,prefix costs2+6 and ell=1/56;2A<->4A at initial1 remains a singleton. Fixtures are source corroboration and were not rerun.
